docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,000.00 FILED BY KWAN, JASON AS TO DEFENDANT GIN, CARY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-05-1993 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT GIN, CARY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING AMENDED JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KWAN, JASON RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GIN, CARY $3,250.00 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,265.00, JUDGMENT NUNC PRO TUNC TO 4/5/93 PER COURT ORDER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KWAN, JASON IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GIN, CARY SETTLEMENT. $100. EACH PAY PERIOD FOR 1ST 5 PAYMTS THEN $125. EVERY PAY PERIOD UNTIL $3250 PD IN FULL STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
